title: Is there anyone here who used to regularly lucid dream and then those dreams turned into the mallworld dream and now you can't lucid dream the same?
content: I didn't often have the awareness but throughout most of my life I could fly on command in my dreams and it came really naturally to me. Over time those dreams lessened and my mallworld dreams took over completely. I'm not sure if this is a common thing or not but I thought I ask!
